title.zh: 禁止在七英寻及以下深度渔区作业拖网的法案
title.en: An Act Prohibiting the Operation of Trawls in Fishing Areas Seven Fathoms Deep or Less
title.orig: An Act Prohibiting the Operation of Trawls in Fishing Areas Seven Fathoms Deep or Less

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3048_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: No person, association or corporation shall operate trawl fishing in fishing areas of the Philippines seven fathoms deep or less: Provided , however , That city and municipal councils may promulgate, subject to the approval of the Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources, ordinances regulating the operation of baby trawls, or those using fishing boats three tons gross or less, in municipal waters.

Any person, association or corporation who violates the provision of this Act shall be punished by a fine not exceeding one thousand pesos or imprisonment not exceeding one year, or both, in the discretion of the Court.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1961
